properties.source: Over the sea: streamline of the July surface wind in the NOAA PSL ICOADS 2-degree monthly long-term mean 1971-2000 (public domain), traced by script and simplified. Arabian Sea branch: cross-equatorial Somali jet turning onto the Konkan coast near 19 N; the short inland end is schematic.
refs: NOAA PSL ICOADS 2-degree enhanced monthly LTM 1971-2000, ERDDAP esrlIcoads2gec71 (accessed 2026-10-12)

properties.source: Over the sea: streamline of the July surface wind in the NOAA PSL ICOADS 2-degree monthly long-term mean 1971-2000 (public domain), traced by script and simplified.
